title: Queering the ethics of AI
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct a benchmark. It mentions the alleged use of AI software by the Chinese government to profile the Islamic minority of Uighurs, indicating a real-world application of AI for profiling based on religious/ethnic identity.
findings: The paper notes that AI can be used for discriminatory purposes against religious minorities, citing the alleged choice of the Chinese government to test profiling software on the Islamic minority of Uighurs. Religion is also mentioned as a protected category in anti-discrimination law that, like other categories, is inadequately addressed by current approaches to AI ethics.
